title: Detailed yo-yo
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- String -->
  <path d='M50 10 Q52 14 50 18 Q48 22 50 26 Q52 30 50 34' fill='none' stroke='#f0f0f0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Yoyo body top half -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='30' ry='12' fill='#ff4444'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='30' ry='12' fill='none' stroke='#ff8888' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Yoyo body bottom half -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='30' ry='12' fill='#cc2222'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='30' ry='12' fill='none' stroke='#ff6666' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Body middle band -->
  <rect x='20' y='48' width='60' height='16' fill='#ff4444'/>
  <rect x='20' y='48' width='60' height='16' fill='none' stroke='#ff9999' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Rim highlight top -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='30' ry='12' fill='none' stroke='#ffaaaa' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Rim highlight bottom -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='30' ry='12' fill='none' stroke='#ff8888' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Decorative stripe around middle -->
  <rect x='20' y='54' width='60' height='4' fill='#ffdd00' rx='1'/>
  <!-- Hub center (axle) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#ffcc00'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='8' ry='4' fill='none' stroke='#ffee66' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='4' ry='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Spokes / star pattern on top face -->
  <line x1='50' y1='38' x2='50' y2='46' stroke='#ffcc00' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='38' y1='42' x2='44' y2='48' stroke='#ffcc00' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='62' y1='42' x2='56' y2='48' stroke='#ffcc00' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='32' y1='48' x2='42' y2='50' stroke='#ffcc00' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='68' y1='48' x2='58' y2='50' stroke='#ffcc00' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Spokes on bottom face -->
  <line x1='50' y1='66' x2='50' y2='74' stroke='#ffcc00' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='38' y1='62' x2='44' y2='66' stroke='#ffcc00' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='62' y1='62' x2='56' y2='66' stroke='#ffcc00' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='32' y1='58' x2='42' y2='58' stroke='#ffcc00' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='68' y1='58' x2='58' y2='58' stroke='#ffcc00' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Edge dots -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='56' r='2.5' fill='#ffcc00'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='56' r='2.5' fill='#ffcc00'/>
  <!-- String loop around axle -->
  <path d='M50 34 Q46 38 46 42 Q46 48 50 50 Q54 52 54 56 Q54 60 50 62' fill='none' stroke='#f0f0f0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Sparkle dots -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='38' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='38' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='68' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='68' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
